title: Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.13293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Serving large language models at high concurrency with long contexts requires KV-cache capacity and attention bandwidth that grow with the decode pool. Existing parallelization strategies trade one against the other: data parallelism replicates model weights, limiting KV capacity; tensor parallelism stops scaling attention at the model's KV-head count and pushes dense collectives across nodes; and decode context parallelism (DCP) recovers capacity by sharding the sequence but adds cross-node aggregation of partial attention results. We observe that during decode, dense layers and attention scale differently: dense layers amortize weight reads across the batch and run efficiently within a single NVLink domain, whereas attention cost grows with every active request's KV cache. translated_title: 解码令牌并行：面向可扩展大语言模型解码的内存高效分布式注意力并行
translated_abstract: 在高并发、长上下文场景下服务大语言模型，需要随解码池规模增长的KV缓存容量与注意力带宽。现有的并行化策略往往顾此失彼：数据并行复制模型权重，限制了KV缓存容量；张量并行在达到模型的KV头数量后便无法继续扩展注意力，并将密集的集合通信推送到节点间；解码上下文并行（DCP）通过对序列分片来恢复容量，但增加了对部分注意力结果的跨节点聚合。我们观察到，在解码阶段，稠密层与注意力的扩展方式不同：稠密层将权重读取摊销到整个批次上，能够在单个NVLink域内高效运行；而注意力的开销则随每个活跃请求的KV缓存而增长。我们提出了解码令牌并行（TKNP），这是一种将权重放置与注意力所有权解耦的解码池架构。TKNP将单一模型进行分布式部署……（摘要原文截断于此）
tldr: 提出解码令牌并行（TKNP）架构，通过将权重放置与注意力所有权解耦，解决了现有并行策略中KV缓存容量与注意力带宽难以兼顾的问题，实现了内存高效且可扩展的大语言模型解码。
en_tdlr: Proposes Decode Token Parallelism (TKNP), a decode-pool architecture that decouples weight placement from attention ownership, enabling memory-efficient and scalable LLM decoding by overcoming the capacity-bandwidth tradeoff in existing parallelization strategies.
